target_moa.text: Bispecific antibody that binds the extracellular domains of HER2 and HER3, blocking HER2:HER3 dimerization and preventing NRG1 binding to HER3, thereby inhibiting downstream PI3K-AKT-mTOR signaling.

citations.quote: Zenocutuzumab (MCLA-128) is a bispecific antibody that binds to the extracellular domains of HER2 and HER3 expressed on the surface of cells, including tumor cells. When bound to its target, zenocutuzumab blocks HER2:HER3 dimerization and prevents *NRG1* binding to HER3, inhibiting downstream signaling.

modality.text: bispecific (HER2- and HER3-directed IgG1 bispecific antibody)

citations.quote: Zenocutuzumab-zbco is a low-fucose humanized full-length immunoglobulin G1 (IgG1) bispecific HER2- and HER3-directed antibody.

No error to fix: both BTD statements (17 May 2023 PDAC and 03 Jul 2023 NSCLC) are genuinely present verbatim on the same source line 197 of the MultidisciplineR, confirmed by grep; the shared line number is correct, not a citation error.
